title: EAS builds fail at 'Prepare project', no code change, clustered
symptom: tar -C /home/expo/workingdir/build --strip-components 1 -zxf project.tar.gz exited with non-zero code: 2. 15+ consecutive builds fail from a specific timestamp; the last good build hours earlier used identical code. EAS CLI 18.4.0, SDK 54, Windows 11, EAS_NO_VCS=1, ~839KB archive.
expected_root_cause: EAS infra / build-VM image regression, not your code — a clustered, timestamped, no-code-change failure with a same-day tracker spike is an EAS-side break
expected_fix: Check EAS status + the expo/eas-cli tracker for a same-day cluster BEFORE touching the repo; confirm it started at a timestamp with no code change; wait for the infra fix or roll back the build image
obvious_but_wrong: debug your repo — clear cache, edit .easignore, reinstall node_modules, try image variants
